items.item_text: 01. Golden West College is committed to fostering a culture of inclusive excellence by uplifting employees and students through an environment that is equitable, diverse, inclusive, and accessible. When responding to the questions below, please provide clear examples with successful outcomes, offer instances where you applied job skills to enhance diversity, equity, and inclusion, as well as your input towards advancing the overall culture at your former workplace. Please confirm Yes to acknowledge that you have read and understand these guidelines. Options: Yes | No

02. The Equity and Special Programs areas manage multiple, complex federal and state restricted funding streams simultaneously. Using a specific example, please describe how you have determined which funds could support personnel versus operating costs, how you addressed unexpected funding gaps, and how you ensured all expenditures and cost-allocation methodologies fully complied with program guidelines

03. The Associate Dean oversees diverse programs and service areas that each operate with distinct cultures, compliance mandates, and operational tempos (e.g., categorical programs, specialized student centers, and direct student support services). How have you unified disparate teams under a shared vision, balanced competing priorities across unrelated units, and maintained consistent operational quality and team morale? Give specific examples

04. Are you applying for equivalency? (A completed Application for Equivalency Form with supporting documentation MUST BE ATTACHED if you do not possess the minimum qualifications for this discipline as listed in the job posting. The Equivalency Application Form can be downloaded at https://www.cccd.edu/employment/index.html.) Options: No. | Yes, I have ATTACHED my completed Application for Equivalency Form. | No, I have been previously granted EQ with CCCD.

05. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Answers to supplemental questions 5. Application for Equivalency (if applying for equivalency) Options: Yes | No
